In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of buoyancy and confinement is more pronounced in the case of aiding buoyancy, while in opposing buoyancy, the effect of confinement is more pronounced.
the flow and heat transfer around a square cylinder is strongly influenced by the channel-confinement as well as the aiding/opposing buoyant force.

channel-confinement enhances the heat transfer from the heated/cooled cylinder, but the effect of aiding buoyancy is found to be beneficial for the heat transfer from a heated cylinder and detrimental for a cooled cylinder.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the buoyancy and channel-confined flows are characterized by a strong vortex shedding and heat transfer enhancement.
the effect of channel-con-finement on the flow and heat transfer around a square cylinder is more significant for the case when buoyancy force is opposing than for aiding buoyancy.
the flow and heat transfer around a square cylinder are significantly affected by the blockage ratio, and the effect of buoyancy is also significant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the channel-confinement has a significant influence on the flow and heat transfer around a square cylinder.
the buoyancy effect on the flow and heat transfer is significantly enhanced in the presence of channel-confinements, especially for blockages of 30% and more.
, the flow and heat transfer around a square cylinder in a channel is significantly different from that in an infinite space.
